- Thinking Modes Catalog: Show all 15 thinking modes organized by their difficulty level (1-4), with each mode's typical workflow stage, giving a quick visual overview of the available reasoning methods.
- Core Data Schemas: Show the key data structures in the system — Mode, Note record, Session record, GuardResult, Settings, and Hook payload — and their relationships.
